metadata.description: EMBER shelter database for 2023 McDougall Creek fire demo scenario
metadata.notes: Capacity estimates are based on EMBC guideline of ~40 sq ft per person for shelter floor use, not venue seating capacity. These are conservative overnight shelter estimates, not processing throughput.

shelters.name: Royal LePage Place
shelters.address: 2760 Cameron Road, West Kelowna, BC V1Z 2T6
shelters.notes: Primary reception centre for evacuees south of Traders Cove. Arena seating capacity 2,600 but shelter floor capacity much lower. Processed thousands of registrations during the event.

shelters.name: Kal Tire Place
shelters.notes: Reception centre for evacuees north of Traders Cove along Westside Road. Approximately 2,500 evacuees were processed through this facility. Located ~60km north of West Kelowna.

shelters.name: Princess Margaret Secondary School
shelters.address: 120 Green Avenue West, Penticton, BC V2A 3T1
shelters.notes: Reception centre south of the fire zone in Penticton. Approximately 350 people received assistance by Aug 20. School gymnasium facility.

shelters.name: The Salvation Army Kelowna
shelters.notes: Additional reception centre opened at 11 PM on Aug 17 after fire jumped Okanagan Lake and threatened Kelowna side. Located in downtown Kelowna.

shelters.name: Prospera Place
shelters.notes: Used for group lodging and reprieve from smoke — NOT a registration/reception centre. 134 people slept there on one peak night with capacity for more. Prioritized for evacuees.
